What actions, if any, have been taken in the last five years to define a long-term strategic vision that supports policy coherence and orients the government and stakeholders towards common sustainable development goals?
Regional and territorial development have been integrated into sectoral policies to enhance synergies between long-term planning and SDG implementation.
A whole-of-government approach has been applied to development finance, in order to diversify the resources beyond official development assistance that support sustainable development impacts.
What steps, if any, have been taken in the last five years to improve whole-of-government coordination and reduce divergences between different sectoral priorities and policies?
Exchanges on knowledge and expertise related to different policy areas with stakeholders. For example, through workshops.
Defined specific commitments on policy coherence for development (PCD) i.e. to consider the transboundary impacts of policies and regulations, including those likely to affect developing countries.
The budgeting process is used as a tool to manage synergies and trade-offs between sectoral policies.
Establishment of clear mandates, capacities and mobilisation of adequate resources to mitigate divergences between sectoral priorities.
Yes, efforts have been made to better align national, regional and local policies with relevant economic, social and environmental goals.
Developed a strategic long-term vision that defines actions to enhance policy coherence.
